regression.durationMeaning: Sum of selected stage durations, including the two parallel toolkit workers; not wall-clock elapsed time.
regression.methodology: The final3 behavior and native Host checks cover the final product source, including internal-note draft preservation, cancel-edit restoration, VirtualRows keyboard focus and reduced measurement work for small-list search. A later first-feedback navigation harness defect omitted BMAD from its button-index order; the corrected harness selects visible labels and asserts completed host.activeMode equals the destination. Product source did not change for that correction; final4-package remains the delivered artifact. Native fixture observations were then corrected without product changes and recompiled in final6-prepare. Every extension/ file in the preserved VSIX was compared with the rebuilt workspace: runtime files and resources are byte-identical, with only the documented deterministic VSCE README-link transformation allowed. The equivalence report and delivered VSIX SHA256 must match before collection; container metadata is excluded. The interrupted baseline and two unsuccessful native observation attempts remain incomplete/failed historical evidence. Accepted native graph runs independently prove the original iframe target disappears after hide, a new target/context/Blob Worker restores finite positions, and unmount terminates its Workers. The unchanged product retains final3 behavior/Host checks. Historical warm-navigation/search paths already used labels, so the observed +11.111% search FAIL is retained and is not attributed to the first-feedback selector bug. Unchanged backend modules retain the successful 497-unit checks from final-unit; unchanged toolkit inputs retain all release checks from final-validation-4, with the toolkit archive SHA256 checked before reuse. Historical failures remain separate from final delivery evidence and do not establish a proven performance root cause.
regression.note: Host 的 opt-in suite 不在一般測試執行；本機 Git GUI／圖譜另有獨立結果，真實 GitLab 未執行。

comparison.note: Observed comparison only. Frame scheduling, GC, machine load and instrumentation add noise; a threshold failure is reported as measured and must not be rewritten as a pass.

packagedRenderer.scope: VSIX packaged assets + isolated mock host UI; no real GitLab, VS Code Extension Host, Git operations or Codex

measurement.latency: Browser-owned readiness observer starts at UI postMessage/input capture; matching rendered DOM followed by two requestAnimationFrame callbacks; driver evaluation only awaits the existing completion promise; excludes Playwright input delivery
measurement.readiness: Navigation matches actual page data-mode; search matches input value and visible repository identities. Five-second timeout; observers and pending animation frames are cleaned up on completion, timeout or supersession.
measurement.memory: Runtime.getHeapUsage after HeapProfiler.collectGarbage at primed, navigation-complete and search-complete checkpoints; parent plus both same-origin Webviews
measurement.scope: VSIX packaged assets + isolated mock host UI; no real GitLab, VS Code Extension Host, Git operations or Codex

firstFeedback.timing: DOM click capture before the UI handler to matching selection, disabled control or visible progress followed by one requestAnimationFrame; scripted DOM activation, excludes native input delivery
firstFeedback.completion: Separately measured event-to-mock-host completion. Artificial host delay is not network or Git performance.

measurementCorrections.correction: The first-feedback navigation harness selected a button by index but omitted BMAD from its mode order. It now selects the visible label and asserts that the completed host.activeMode equals the requested destination. The interrupted baseline is retained as incomplete tool evidence; delivery baseline and revision are rerun with the same corrected harness.
measurementCorrections.historicalMetrics: Warm navigation and repository search already selected visible labels. The previously measured +11.111% repository-search FAIL remains valid historical evidence and is not reclassified by the first-feedback selector correction.

preDraftRendererObservation.note: 此中間候選配對量測的本機搜尋回退超過 10%，比較結果為 FAIL；暖切頁與搜尋當時已使用可見 label，原量測 FAIL 不受後來 first-feedback navigation 索引誤點影響。retained heap、舊工具記錄的 8×100 回饋與 smoke 結果保留，但舊 navigation 回饋不作完整驗收。搜尋回退原因尚未證實，後續程式修正與 delivery 新一輪量測不能覆寫本輪失敗，也不構成根因已定位的證據。

comparison.reason: Comparison requires distinct artifacts, identical harness/fixture/browser/method and complete 10 × 30 samples.

initialRendererObservation.note: 舊候選完整量測的 refresh 第 13 次未被量測到可見回饋；同一舊候選獨立 refresh 100 次診斷又通過，原失敗尚未完全重現定位。後續補強按鈕同步 busy/aria/text 與 100 輪回歸，不能以此宣稱舊失敗原因已證實。初次暖切頁 24.6→29.4 ms 的觀測保留，最終另以相鄰時段與同一量測程式比較，不覆寫舊結果。

snapshotBenchmark.methodology: Production WorkspacePanel.sendSnapshot, fixed same-scope local inventory, real JSON serialization; 30 selection updates for daily/medium workloads and three bounded stress updates. The Skills context is pinned to isolate workspace updates. No VS Code bridge, renderer, disk or GitLab network is measured.

workloads.limitation: Three stress samples bound the expensive legacy work; no p95 is reported for this workload.

各真實環境 10 次冷啟動、每輪 30 次暖切頁與搜尋；含 Extension Host、GitLab 網路及完整峰值記憶體。
工作台骨架／離線入口 p95 ≤1 秒，以及全部隱藏／取消路徑 ≤1 秒的實機量測。
矩陣中仍為 pending 的逐項取消、重試、範圍切換或恢復情境；完整測試通過不會自動提升這些狀態。
limitations: 封裝 Renderer 比較使用 20 Repo 的隔離 mock host，10 個新 Browser context，每輪 30 次暖切頁及搜尋；不是 10 次真實 VS Code 程序冷啟動。
Renderer 記憶體是 GC 後 retained heap；不等於 Extension Host 或整個應用程式峰值。
工作台快照量測涵蓋 50/500/2000 Repo 與 100/1000/10000 Issue，僅量測 host 計算與 JSON 序列化；壓力負載只有 3 筆，未報 p95。
圖譜比較每負載 3 輪，選取共 90 筆、縮放共 45 筆；2000 節點以 Canvas/Worker 執行，初始掛載仍可出現 >50 ms 長任務。
早期 sandbox 啟動失敗、舊 fixture 及已修正的回歸失敗保留於原始 optimization 目錄；此報告引用最後完整通過的一輪。
